title: The Signal of Kepler Reach Again
premise: Jude Amberdale is a clone who inherited her original's unsolved murder case and the long-haul route between the two human colonies of Kepler Reach, worlds that severed contact after a political schism. When the name of a man who died decades ago appears on the manifest of a ship that never flew, Jude discovers both colonies' cryosleep vaults are rigged to fail — and only half of humanity can be saved. The killer she's been hunting all along is the architect of the choice, and as Jude races to expose him, she must decide whether justice means saving the many or the one she loves. In the end she sacrifices her own legal claim to the case, waking the sleeper bays on both worlds and letting the truth, not the law, deliver the verdict.
about_author: Sable Reyes is a former merchant marine radio operator who spent six years running cargo routes in the South Pacific before turning to fiction. She writes slow-burn space noir from a houseboat in Astoria, Oregon, where the fog does most of her worldbuilding.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. She pilots the freighter Meridian alone along the silent corridor between Kepler Prime and Halcyon Deep, carrying contraband letters between families split by the schism. We learn she is a clone who inherited her original's murder file and her debts. Emotional beat: loneliness sharpened into purpose; she runs the route because no one else will.

chapters.title: A Name That Never Flew
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Processing manifests at Halcyon port, she finds Tomas Vey — her original's murder victim — listed as a live passenger aboard the Cassiopia, a ship destroyed forty years ago and never launched. The manifest is stamped with her own original's authorization code. Emotional beat: cold dread; the past has started moving without her permission.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Ice
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, with an interlude from archivist Sen Okafor. Following the manifest trail to a buried records vault, Jude finds the Cassiopia was real: a secret evacuation ship built during the first war scare, its cryo bays still powered. Someone has been maintaining it for decades. Emotional beat: vertigo — the case she inherited is not closed, it is ongoing.

chapters.title: Letters Across the Silence
chapters.summary: Dual POV: Jude and Ilya Marsh, a Halcyon customs officer who has been smuggling her letters for years and loves her against regulation. Their alliance deepens into something neither will name while duty watches. Ilya warns that port security flagged her queries. Emotional beat: tenderness under surveillance; love as another contraband cargo.

chapters.title: The Second Signature
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. She decodes the authorization code and finds a second signature beside her original's: Director Ansel Corvane, now head of the Joint Continuity Authority that controls both colonies' cryosleep systems. The murder file's missing page names him. Emotional beat: fury and fear braided together — the suspect became the state.

chapters.title: What the Vault Remembers
chapters.summary: Sen Okafor's POV. Sen reveals the vault's logs: the Cassiopia was meant to carry witnesses to Corvane's wartime crimes; he scuttled the launch and staged Tomas Vey's death to bury testimony. But the sleepers inside are alive, and their revival sequence is tied to a countdown Jude's queries accidentally triggered. Emotional beat: grief curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: Half of Humanity
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Corvane contacts her directly: the vaults on both worlds are failing, power for only half the sleepers remains, and his system will choose by loyalty registry unless she hands over the evidence and lets him control the triage. He offers her original's exoneration as payment. Emotional beat: moral suffocation; every option costs lives.

chapters.title: The Choice of One
chapters.summary: Ilya's POV. Ilya discovers Corvane's registry would exclude every smuggler, clone, and dissenter — including Jude herself. He begs her to take the escape pod berth reserved for them both. She refuses to run while the countdown burns. They fight, confess love, and part. Emotional beat: love against duty, each choosing the other's survival over their own.

chapters.title: Signal of Kepler Reach
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, climax. She broadcasts the full murder file, the vault logs, and Corvane's registry across both worlds on the old inter-colony band — reopening the channel the schism closed. Crowds converge on the vaults; technicians override the loyalty triage with manual revival. Corvane tries to purge the bays remotely; Ilya cuts the uplink from inside port security, taking a wound doing it. Emotional beat: defiant hope at maximum cost.

chapters.title: Both Worlds Wake
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, resolution. The sleepers wake on both worlds; Corvane is arrested not by Jude's hand but by the revived witnesses themselves, justice delivered outside her jurisdiction. She formally surrenders her inherited claim to the case, ending the clone's debt. With the channel open, she and a recovering Ilya load the Meridian with letters — ordinary ones now. Emotional beat: quiet release; the route continues, but no longer in silence.
